$comment: Baseline of tests that are CURRENTLY FAILING because they have found a real
defect that has not been fixed yet. `npm test` compares each run against
this file:
- a failure listed here         -> reported as KNOWN, does not fail the run
- a failure NOT listed here     -> reported as NEW REGRESSION, fails the run
- a listed test that now PASSES -> reported as FIXED; delete its entry
This keeps the suite usable as a merge gate while documented defects are
still open, without ever hiding them. Every entry must name the defect and
where the fix belongs -- an entry with no `fix` is not allowed to be added.
Match is on the test's full name (suite path + test title), substring-matched.
THE LIST IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY. scripts/run-test-suite.mjs already treated a
missing file as an empty baseline, so adding it changes no behaviour today --
it exists so the mechanism is discoverable, and so CI has something to point
at. Measured on main at 8a98d89 on 2026-10-26: typecheck, lint and 126/126
node tests pass, components is 0/0 (no component specs), build passes and e2e
skips for want of specs. An empty baseline is the honest state, not an
oversight.
Known NOT to belong here, for the avoidance of a future mistake: the
'zero-sum schedule conservation' invariant fails against the pipeline output
sitting UNCOMMITTED in the working tree on 2026-10-26 (sum(proj_wins)=331.00
against total_schedule_games=330). It passes at HEAD. That is a live exporter
defect in a fresh run, not a standing one, and baselining it would be exactly
the suppression this file is designed to prevent.
